```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "The sizing ignores the fixed 0.75 V gate bias: M1 carries 0.96 mA instead of 2 mA, so Vout sits at 1.37 V. I calibrate W so the drain current at vcm equals I, and lower R_load to 400 ohm to set Vout near mid-supply and keep the pole above 590 MHz."}
```

The root cause is that `lut.size` picks W from the gm/Id target, which implies a Vgs different from the 0.75 V bias, so the real current at Vgs = 0.75 V is about half of I. The fix is to fix the width at the actual bias. I also reduce R_load so that I·R sets Vout near 1.0 V at 1.8 V, which leaves room for swing on both sides.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),           # signal nFET gm/Id used as initial sizing guess [S/A]
    "L_n": (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),               # signal nFET length [um]
    "R_load": (400.0, 250.0, 500.0),       # pull-up resistor [ohm]; upper bound keeps f3dB > 590 MHz
    "I": (2.0e-3, 1.6e-3, 2.2e-3),         # signal branch current at vcm [A]
}

VDD_MIN, VDD_MAX = 1.62, 1.98
CORNERS = [("tt", 27), ("ss", 125), ("ss", -40), ("ff", -40),
           ("ff", 125), ("sf", 27), ("fs", 27)]


def _solve_vout(L_, W, Ln, R, vdd_c, vcm):
    """Bisection: Vout = VDD - R*Id_n(vcm, Vout). Id_n rises with Vout (channel-length modulation)."""
    lo, hi = 0.02, vdd_c - 0.01
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        In = L_.op("n", W, Ln, vcm, vds=mid)["Id"]
        f = vdd_c - R * In - mid        # decreasing in mid
        if f > 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)


def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    vcm = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 20e-6)
    I = p["I"]
    R = p["R_load"]
    L_n = p["L_n"]

    # Initial sizing from gm/Id intent, then calibrate W so that the
    # drain current at the actual gate bias (vcm) equals I.
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], L_n, I, vds=0.6)
    W0 = m1.W
    W = W0
    for _ in range(2):
        idop = lut.op("n", W, L_n, vcm, vds=0.6)["Id"]
        W = W * I / idop
    cdd = m1.cdd * W / W0

    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)            # reference sink (diode-connected)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W, L_n)  # common-source nFET, width calibrated to I at vcm
    n.R("RL", "vdd", "vout", R)                             # resistive pull-up
    n.dev("Mb", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)         # reference sink

    cout = cl + cdd

    gain_wc, f3db_wc, gbw_wc = 1e9, 1e9, 1e9
    vout_lo = 1e9
    swing_wc, head_wc = 1e9, 1e9

    for corner, temp in CORNERS:
        L_ = lut.at(corner, temp)
        for vdd_c in (VDD_MIN, VDD_MAX):
            vout = _solve_vout(L_, W, L_n, R, vdd_c, vcm)
            a = L_.op("n", W, L_n, vcm, vds=vout)

            gtot_c = 1.0 / R + a["gds"]
            gain_c = a["gm"] / gtot_c
            f_c = gtot_c / (2 * PI * cout)
            gbw_c = a["gm"] / (2 * PI * cout)

            gain_wc = min(gain_wc, gain_c)
            f3db_wc = min(f3db_wc, f_c)
            gbw_wc = min(gbw_wc, gbw_c)
            vout_lo = min(vout_lo, vout)
            head_wc = min(head_wc, vout - a["vdsat"])

            half = min(vout - a["vdsat"], vdd_c - vout)
            swing_wc = min(swing_wc, 2 * half)

    power_mw = 1e3 * VDD_MAX * (I + iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain_wc),
        "f3db": f3db_wc / 1e6,      # MHz
        "gbw": gbw_wc / 1e6,        # MHz
        "power": power_mw,          # mW
        "vout_dc": vout_lo,         # V, worst (lowest) DC level
        "swing": swing_wc,          # V, peak-to-peak
        "headroom_n": head_wc,      # V, worst vout - Vdsat(M1)
    }
```
